name: Dranzer G
description: Dranzer G: a Balance phoenix with two unique abilities and one Special.

ability.name: Gravity Flame
ability.description: Every successful Attack increases ATK by 4%. Maximum 5 stacks (20% ATK). Stacks last until battle ends.

special_move.name: G-Revolution Inferno
special_move.description: Base damage: 145 + 65% ATK. Ignores 12% enemy DEF. Consumes all Gravity Flame stacks. Each consumed stack adds 12 bonus damage. Cooldown: 4 rounds.

abilities.name: Gravity Flame
abilities.description: Every successful Attack increases ATK by 4%. Maximum 5 stacks (20% ATK). Stacks last until battle ends.

abilities.name: Phoenix Rotation
abilities.description: After using Stamina, recover 6% of missing HP. Gain 10% DEF for 2 rounds. Cooldown: 3 rounds.
